SELECT k.id, k.title, k.summary, k.status, k.category_id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName, u.nickname AS authorName, k.view_count AS viewCount, k.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM knowledge_item k LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = k.category_id LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = k.author_id
AND k.category_id IN #{cid}
AND k.status = #{status}
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM item_tag it WHERE it.item_id = k.id AND it.tag_id = #{tagId})
AND (k.status = 'PUBLISHED' OR k.author_id = #{visibleAuthorId})
AND k.status = 'PUBLISHED'
ORDER BY k.updated_at DESC, k.id DESC
